description: Needs sign-in (connect this server with OAuth, or pass an API key as the Authorization: Bearer header). Creates a community YG Dolphin listing (no web build) for a catalog base game, owned by the creator on this connection. YG Dolphin packs: a listing (orca_listing_create) holds no files; its versions are flat packs (mod.json format 2 and at most 7 files it names). For each file: pack_file start {name, bytes, sha256} answers have:true when the listing already stores it, else an upload with part URLs: PUT each part's exact bytes to its URL (Content-Length as given), then pack_file complete. Then pack_publish_version with mod.json's text and the files. YouGame checks security only (format, sizes, disc images, retail files by hash) and signs it within a minute; pack_set stable makes it the one players get. Players play on their own disc in the desktop app, jailed. Never upload a game's disc or its retail files.

base_game.description: The catalog base game as GET /api/base/search and /api/base/dumps give it (players need their own disc of it), without runtime.

profile.description: The game's six-character disc ID (A-Z 0-9), or PPLUS32 for Project+ 3.2.

thumbnail_url.description: Existing site art: /base-art/covers/<game>.webp. A preview video in uploadId is recommended.

uploadId.description: An owned staged upload with a thumbnail uploaded through /api/agent/media (required for public agent listings unless thumbnail_url supplies existing base art).

name: orca_listing_create
